direction.camera: Guide attention with analog mood; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: treat each shot as a deliberate photographic frame; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with film grain; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with photographic frame.
direction.lighting: soft practical key; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: film-like texture and warm print; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around patient cut; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use analog mood,film grain,soft shoulder,warm shadow,patient cut,photographic frame as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
